name: spin-gentle
description: Handoff validation at moderate speed: 1.5 A through the cold start (align 0.3 s + early runaway handoff ~0.43 s after engage), then IMMEDIATELY drop to 0.3 A so the unloaded rotor settles at a moderate speed — the current loop's dq oscillation grows with w_e (undercompensated decoupling, AC-L work pending) and trips overcurrent near ~800 rad/s at 1.5 A. 1 kHz capture (10 kHz drive capture blocked on the ISR-glue refactor).
